text:
ryan: deploy-bot flagged canary publish for service-payment:v2026.03.21-1451 — blocked by provenance check (KMS annotation region mismatch). Pushing here to coordinate pin/rollback. https://ci.redwood.internal/12345

deploy-bot: CANARY_PUBLISH_BLOCKED service-payment:v2026.03.21-1451 -> reason=provenance.annotation_kms_region_mismatch
```error: provenance validation failed
  expected.kms_region=us-west-2
  found.kms_region=eu-west-1
  artifact=service-payment@sha256:abcdef1234567890
```

jess: Is this the same artifact we pushed earlier or did two builders run?

ryan: Build metadata shows cosign attestation OK, but KMS key annotations were set to eu-west-1 while the ECR mirror expects us-west-2. Looks like a cross-region KMS was used by the builder. Probably safe to pin to previous digest for staging.

mike: Pin to previous digest SGTM for now. Any risk the layers actually changed? :eyes:

ryan: I ran a layer-check (content-hash compare) — layers identical. Only annotation differs. Note: deploy-bot enforces kms_region == registry_region to avoid replay/misuse.

olivia: Change window open until 18:00 PST. If canary is blocked we have two options: manual promote the pinned digest or republish with local KMS and resign. I recommend pin + republish.

jess: I'll prepare a retag/resign job: plan -> pull service-payment@sha256:abcdef1234567890, resign with us-west-2 KMS key, push as service-payment:staging-resigned-1761234567. Will coordinate infra creds.

deploy-bot: PIN_RECORD_CREATED service-payment@sha256:abcdef1234567890 pinned -> pinned_by=ryan reason="kms_region mismatch"

mike: Can we just rewrite the annotation in-place? My understanding is cosign signature covers annotations so we need to resign.

ryan: Correct — must resign. Jess, please ensure new attestation metadata includes kms_region=us-west-2 and cosign signature verified. @sara please add a line to release notes about this canary hold.

sara: Will do. Adding: "staging canary held: service-payment pinned due to KMS annotation region mismatch; manual republish planned."

jess: Kicked off manual republish job and created INFRA ticket: https://issues.redwood.internal/INFRA-789. Posting updates here.

deploy-bot: CANARY_REINSTATE_ATTEMPT skipped (pin active)

ryan: Decision summary: 1) Pin staging to previous digest (sha256:abcdef1234567890). 2) Infra to republish/resign with us-west-2 KMS and push new tag. 3) Re-run canary within change window. No prod rollback required. I'll update the runbook and ping on re-run results.
